investigator.title: How to Be a Good Investigator
investigator.lede: Weird stories are a blast. Good agents still ask: What is the evidence?

steps.title: Separate story from proof
steps.body: A campfire tale can be fun and unproven. Label legend, rumor, or documented fact.

steps.title: Eyewitnesses can be honest and wrong
steps.body: Night lights, distance, and animals fool us. Ask what, how far, how long, weather.

steps.title: Blurry photos need context
steps.body: Date, place, camera, crop? Dust and bugs fake orbs.

steps.title: Check sources
steps.body: Prefer parks, museums, newspapers, and books that cite records. Beware rage-click videos.

steps.title: Two things can be true
steps.body: Real history AND tourist legends can share a place—don’t mix the labels.

steps.title: Be kind and legal
steps.body: Public land, outside gates, quiet at memorials. Never trespass for content.

adult.label: Adult
adult.blurb: Uncensored: political conspiracy culture, darker history, cover-up debates. Believers vs documented. Not for kids.

NV.believers_say: Believers: reverse-engineered craft, alien bodies, black-budget tech; some Q-adjacent forums fold Area 51 into secret space / elite breakaway myths.
NV.documented: Documented: Groom Lake is a real classified flight-test site. Secrecy ≠ proof of nonhuman bodies. Storm-the-gates stunts were illegal/dangerous.
NV.darker_context: Roast hype machines and anonymous insiders equally; Cold War cover stories bred folklore.

NM.believers_say: Believers: nonhuman crash; Roswell as sacred UFO/apocalyptic myth site.
NM.documented: Documented: 1947 statement whiplash; later USAF Project Mogul discussions; tourism economy.
NM.darker_context: Separate memory, CYA, and grift—don’t state corpse photos as fact.

TX.believers_say: Believers: Marfa lights as spirits/craft; Dealey Plaza camps from left/right/fringe argue lone gunman vs conspiracy.
TX.documented: Documented: Marfa viewing area; JFK assassinated 1963; Warren Commission Oswald-alone; HSCA later discussed possible conspiracy while criticizing agencies.
TX.darker_context: Roast partisan conspiracy entrepreneurs on all sides; don’t mush Marfa into Dealey Plaza.

CO.believers_say: Believers: DIA elite bunkers, occult murals, NWO; Q drops recycled airport memes.
CO.documented: Documented: odd public art + utility tunnels; no public doomsday city tours.

UT.believers_say: Believers: Dugway chem/bio + UFO desert myths (not the Jetty).
UT.documented: Documented: Army range; 1968 Skull Valley sheep kill linked to nerve-agent testing; Jetty is land art.
UT.darker_context: Accountability for real testing without every online escalation.

MD.believers_say: Believers: NSA omniscience; museum as limited hangout; every side claims they’re the only target.
MD.documented: Documented: public Cryptologic Museum; FISA/Snowden-era debates on record.
MD.darker_context: Roast selective outrage across administrations; FOIA > vibes.

WV.believers_say: Believers: Mothman omen tied to Silver Bridge.
WV.documented: Documented: 1966 reports as folklore history; 1967 collapse killed 46; engineering eyebar analyses common.
WV.darker_context: Don’t treat mass death as cryptid plot armor.

PA.darker_context: Neglect is enough—no demons; no trespass.

MA.believers_say: Believers: politicized witch-hunt rhetoric both ways.
MA.darker_context: Moral panic lessons without cheap partisanship.

CA.documented: Documented: decades of building; motive vs tourism myth debated.
CA.darker_context: Grief/wealth/gun-fortune ethics—don’t assert séances as fact.

FL.believers_say: Believers: elite utilidors; Triangle doom; Florida-as-psyop memes.
FL.documented: Documented: backstage logistics; Triangle as media region with many prosaic explanations.
FL.darker_context: Roast psyop memes and glib risk denial; Adult-only nastiness exists online.

VA.believers_say: Believers: D.C. spillover cover-up tourism; Navy secrecy as proof of any viral claim.
VA.documented: Documented: Luray show cave; Hampton Roads major Navy region—secrecy normal ≠ one claim proven.

SD.believers_say: Believers: Illuminati vault under Rushmore; political fights over meaning.
SD.documented: Documented: unfinished Hall of Records niche; Borglum history; Black Hills sacred—dispossession context.
SD.darker_context: Monument politics with sources; reject vault fanfic as fact.

HI.darker_context: Respect tradition; trust USGS on hazards.

beltway.title: Beltway / D.C. spillover lore
beltway.believers_say: Q-style storm prophecies, elite tunnels, Freemason mall myths, and mirror-image deep-state novels from opposing camps.
beltway.documented: Real power, real secrecy elsewhere, real museums. Extraordinary claims need documents; many Q timelines failed openly.
beltway.darker_context: Roast grifters on all sides. Media literacy > hashtag revelation. Never show in Kids mode.
